scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:ingest && pnpm run deploy:web
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types -c wrangler.web.jsonc -c wrangler.ingest.jsonc && react-router typegen && tsc -b
scripts.test:homologation: vitest run --project unit tests/unit/store-contracts.test.ts tests/unit/source-identity.test.ts tests/unit/destination-policy.test.ts tests/unit/robots-policy.test.ts tests/unit/closin-fixtures.test.ts tests/unit/closin-budgets.test.ts tests/unit/voolt3d-fixtures.test.ts tests/unit/voolt3d-budgets.test.ts tests/unit/store-binding-and-imports.test.ts tests/unit/store-runtime-resolution.test.ts
scripts.test:pipeline: vitest run --project unit tests/unit/story-1-3-contracts.test.ts tests/unit/story-1-3-pipeline.test.ts && vitest run --project workers tests/workers/publication-pipeline.test.ts tests/workers/multi-store-isolation.test.ts
scripts.test:search: vitest run --project unit tests/unit/story-1-4-contracts.test.ts tests/unit/get-search-page.test.ts tests/unit/contracts-and-bindings.test.ts tests/unit/rpc-client.test.ts && vitest run --project workers tests/workers/search-pipeline.test.ts tests/workers/multi-store-isolation.test.ts && vitest run --project e2e tests/e2e/search-route.e2e.test.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply filatracker-local --local -c wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
